classification.rationale: The description names two articles, so the first-named, inductive loops, is classified. An inductive loop embedded in the road changes inductance when a vehicle passes and sends that signal to a separate counter, so it functions as an electrical transducer rather than a counter or an insulated cable. Transducers are provided for in 8543.70.45.00 ('electric synchros and transducers ... other'), the line CBP used in N362482 for a magnetic axle sensor acting as a transducer. No ruling on traffic loops was found, so confidence is low.
